what: third recompute of the 2026-10-26 Ironclad release sweep from the raw rows; every value it shares with primary.json, primary.md, blind.json, the logs and the published 2026-10-11 column, compared with explicit tolerances
qualifier_new: Ironclad, champion a10_it700, ppo.probe net_greedy, act1 roll, 8000/8000 sims in one tree, shipped GH #830 default (knobs + BC prior in elite/boss + rl2 playout net), engine 0181fa552, PGO src_hash 4e5bb730d28e2976, seeds 81,000,000+ (200 at A0-A8, 500 at A9-A10)
qualifier_old: Ironclad, champion plr_it550, same driver, budget and seeds, engine 0cab615a3, pre-#830 search, no rl2 playout net (2026-10-11 release sweep)

tolerances.printed_1dp: string equality of the value formatted to 1 decimal in percent

tolerance_notes.full: primary.json floats vs this recompute: same formulas, only summation order may differ
tolerance_notes.r6: blind.json writes floats rounded to 6 decimals
tolerance_notes.p_rel: relative; McNemar p down to 1.7e-13 must agree to ~3 significant figures
tolerance_notes.method: the pooled-diff CI by percentile bootstrap vs the blind's analytic seed-clustered normal CI
tolerance_notes.mc: the pre-registered bootstrap RNG seed vs five other RNG seeds
tolerance_notes.z: primary uses z = 1.959964 (Phi^-1(0.975)) for Wilson/Newcombe and also reports z = 1.96; the blind uses z = 1.96; each is compared with this recompute at its own z; 'z_choice' checks show the choice is invisible at 1 decimal

verdict.statement: 0 mismatches in 1925 compared values on the current files; before the two reporting fixes there were 5 (0 unexplained), all from F1 (blind.json p-value rounding) or F2 (primary.md '3,400')

fixes.bug: r6() rounded every float to 6 decimal places before writing blind.json, so the exact McNemar p-values below 1e-3 lost their precision: A10 p = 1.70e-13 and A9 p = 5.81e-10 were written as 0.0, and A8 p = 2.037e-4 as 0.000204. An exact binomial p is never 0. Only the JSON was wrong: the blind's stdout table (format 9.2e) and the blind agent's report carried the right values.
fixes.evidence: prefix_snapshot/blind.json paired_vs_old.A9/A10.mcnemar_exact_p = 0.0; scipy binomtest(143, 199) = 5.806e-10, binomtest(104, 127) = 1.696e-13; primary.json has the same values at full precision.
fixes.change: r6() keeps 6 significant digits for nonzero |x| < 1e-3 and still rounds to 6 decimals otherwise. No other line changed.

fixes.bug: render_md() hard-coded '3,400' in the mean A0-A10 row of primary.md, in both the n and the pairs column. The sweep has 2,800 runs per arm (9 x 200 + 2 x 500) and 2,800 pairs. The 3,400 came from the task text; primary.json was never affected (its integrity block says 2800).
fixes.evidence: prefix_snapshot/primary.md mean row '| **mean A0-A10** | 3,400 | ... | 3,400 |'; 2,800 rows in cells/*.jsonl; runs.csv holds 2,800 Ironclad rows.
fixes.change: The mean row's n and pairs columns are summed from the per-level tables. No other line changed.
